Job description:
Artificial Intelligence, Automation, and Business Development Specialist (Remote). We are building an AI-based platform in the real estate industry and are looking for someone who is interested in playing a key role in building a real and long-term product. For success in this role, curiosity, continuous learning, and a desire to build are as important as technical knowledge. Main responsibilities include designing and developing workflows with Google Workspace, Airtable, and automation tools to build and optimize processes with n8n, Make, and APIs; professional use of ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools for research, experimentation, and implementing new AI tools; generating professional content for websites, social networks, articles, advertising campaigns, and landing pages with the help of AI; providing ideas and executing solutions to increase lead generation; collaborating on developing the project's smart infrastructure and documenting processes. Expected skills include proficiency in ChatGPT and Claude, familiarity with Google Workspace, experience with Airtable, familiarity with n8n or Make, familiarity with APIs, investigating and suggesting new AI tools to increase team productivity, the ability to research, learn quickly, and problem-solve, the ability to generate professional content with AI assistance, responsibility, organization, and a long-term collaborative spirit, familiarity with Google Ads, SEO, WordPress, Webflow, or building an AI Agent are considered points. You will work directly with the project manager in this role and participate in technical and product development decisions. The collaboration is currently remote. The long-term project payment is based on ability, output quality, and level of responsibility. There is an opportunity for growth in an innovative project. If you feel you are only looking for a job, this opportunity may not be suitable for you. We are looking for a long-term collaboration with someone who wants to play a role in building a real and valuable product. To submit your application, please send the following in addition to your resume: a link to portfolio or completed projects, a 2 to 3-minute video introducing yourself and explaining what value you will create for the project in the first 30 days if you join our team. For us, the quality of the portfolio, the way of thinking, and the problem-solving ability are more important than the number of years of experience.

Company description:
AI and Technology Startup in the Real Estate Industry. Puzzle is a technology and artificial intelligence project currently in development, focusing on the real estate industry by building smart infrastructure for managing, marketing, and developing businesses. Our goal is not just to build a software; it is to create a system that uses artificial intelligence, automation, and data analysis to make business processes simpler, faster, and smarter. We are looking to build a small, professional, and long-term team; a team whose members, in addition to technical skills, are interested in learning, innovation, and participating in building a real product. If you would like to work on a project that has room for growth, learning, and real impact, we would be happy to get to know you.
